notes.title: Wibbly Witches Armaments Update + New Game!
notes.content:
[p]Wibbly Witches - Armaments Update is out now, plus I have released a brand new game!  Thank you to everyone who has played over the last four and a half years! I've returned to Wibbly Witches and will be releasing a few small updates, adding new cosmetics and polishing the optional content in the game.[/p][previewyoutube="r61UDC1FWeM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
This updates adds three new skins, each with multiple colour options.
And new weapons you can activate by turning off all the spells:
-Minigun
-Shotgun
-Sniper
-Grenade

The bubble spell now charges faster and the yoink spell gets reversed gravity after travelling through fire.
Also there's a few changes to some levels.[/p][p] I'm increasing the price of Wibbly Witches with this update, it's something I should have done a while ago as there's now so much more content than when it first released. The next updates will add more cosmetics, focus on enhancing a few modifiers and improving the melee arena.[/p][p]-------------  [/p][p]Over the last few years I have been creating an educational game called Aggi's Tiny Friends, it's all about microbiology and is based on some books written by my mum. Join Aggi and dive into a world that lies just out of sight. Customize your own cell and see it thrive in a vibrant ecosystem. Discover a wide variety of organisms like you've never seen before. And learn real science in a playful and relaxed environment. You can get Aggi's Tiny Friends on Steam now![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3190840/Aggis_Tiny_Friends/"][/dynamiclink]-------------

Last year I did have a look into adding online multiplayer to Wibbly Witches but it seemed like it would be way too much work to retrofit it into the game when it wasn't designed for it from the beginning. For my next Steam release I'm planning to make an online multiplayer game.


You can find me on Bluesky where I'll be posting updates on all my projects:
[url="https://bsky.app/profile/autumnlavender.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/autumnlavender.bsky.social[/url][/p]

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Spell Update
notes.content:
[h1]A new update for Wibbly Witches.[/h1]

[previewyoutube=wu1mE1WaV_s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Adding new spells and match settings[/h2]
[h3]New Spells:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bludgeon
A powerful midrange spell, fire quick explosive projectiles that pass through walls.
[*]Bubble
Previously only obtainable in the pond arena, lift objects and opponents into the air.
[*]Yoink
A quick and funny little spell that pulls your enemies towards you, allowing you to snatch their stuff.
[*]Delay
Place timed explosives around the arena.
[/list]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Hazard Level
After unlocking a few arenas you get the ability to set the amout of stage hazards.
[*]Stage Time Limit
Now if you take too long on a stage the borders of the screen slowly close in.
[*]Time Limit Options
Once unlocking a few modifiers you unlock the time limit setting wich allows you to turn the timer off or start the walls closing in immediately.
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
Because of how poorly I coded the spell unlocks, adding new spells meant I had to reset your unlocked spells... sorry.
You now get more keys after finishing a match, so you will now unlock things at a faster rate.
Small graphical changes.
Small level design changes.

[h3]New Secrets:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pressing the zero key a bunch of times allows you to spawn in keys at the end of the match. (Only do this if you can't be bothered to unlock everything the intended way)
[*]Turning off all spells now fills the arena with a new secret item.
[/list]

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Brewery Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Two new arena types[/h2]
The brewery:
- Large cauldrons spew out magical bubbles in a gothic castle filled with spells and floating candles.

The secret arena:
- Access by starting a match with no levels selected.
- New hazards
- No spells
- Collect magical stars to power up your melee attack and send your friends flying out of the arena


New advanced levels have been added, mixing the hazards from the brewery into all other arenas.

[h2]Additional changes[/h2]
New music.
Reworked effects.
Bug fixes.

[previewyoutube=LHV-nfeAIvs;full][/previewyoutube]

You can now find the soundtrack on Youtube!
[previewyoutube=j0GbPXjcBgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[h1]A new update to mark one year of Wibbly Witches![/h1]
Featuring a complete rework to the advanced levels, new music, hazards and a new secret spell.

[previewyoutube=ml0cLiNc-HA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New features[/h2]
Advanced levels are now heavily procedurally generated, combining features from all of the arena types in one place.

[h3]New level elements[/h3]
Floating candles will add extra spells to some levels
Spinning platforms constantly shift the arena
Powerful bubble boosters will launch you to new heights
Giant atractors pull projectiles and players towards them
New variants of explosive barrel
And you can now find chests for every spell in the game

[h3]Spell changes[/h3]
A new rare spell can be found in the advanced levels
The thunder spell can now deflect projectiles

[h3]Two new music tracks[/h3]
New music for the advanced levels
New variant for the end of a match


Thanks to everyone who's played and stuck around this long!

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Newt Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Pond arena is here![/h1]
Introducing newts, snails, bubble jets and a new level specific spell to play with.

[h2]This update also includes:[/h2]
Two new rare music tracks

Changes to the tome spell to make it a bit more useful

A new advanced movement technique where attacking something below you and jumping at the same time gives you extra height

Small changes to old levels

And new improved visual effects
[list]
[*]Markers have been added for when players are off-screen
[*]Lava now flashes before falling from the ceiling
[*]Brooms on the ground now have an idle animation and improved visuals
[*]The Second Chance modifier now shows a symbol moving from your character to where you will 
re-spawn
[/list]

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Frost Update
notes.content:
[h1]This small content update adds the first of three new arenas - Frost.[/h1]
The new level features all new hazards
[list]
[*]A glowing snow flake that duplicates all spells shot into it.
[*]Cages chained to the ceiling that can be used as platforms or dropped on your foes.
[/list]

notes.title: Wibbly Witches Spell Update
notes.content:
This update adds four new spells:
[list]
[*] Thunder - Launch a powerful shockwave to fling your opponents into oblivion.
[*] Tome - Create a magic book that will fire a homing spell at anyone who comes near.
[*] Potion - Shower your friends with a volley of bottles.
[*] *Potion* - Obliterate everything with a carpet of explosive potions.
[/list]
And three new modifiers:
[list]
[*] Second chance - Each level you respawn once atop a broom.
[*] No charge - All spells charge instantly and have a quicker respawn time.
[*] Dig - Carve tunnels through the ground.
[/list]
There have also been a few small changes to some levels and effects.

I'm also hard at work making new arenas which I'll release one at a time.
